contributions.detail: One row, 300,00 (comma separator), = the Form A printed TOTAL 300.00 = the only figure the filer entered on cover line 1. THIS and CUMULATIVE are blank on every cover line: this filer entered his whole report in the 'Totals from LAST Report' column - the module's published cover transcription records the same quirk. Scope decided independently and NOT from this cover: the December filing by the same filer in the same cycle (key 7194bf78, also in this chunk) staples a PHOTOCOPY of this exact Form A sheet under a cover whose CUMULATIVE line 1 reads 300.00 and whose THIS-report line 1 is a slashed zero, which proves the ledger is cycle-to-date. The row's date 2020-04-08 also falls inside this report's certified period 3/13/20-6/15/20, and this is the first report of the cycle, so period and cumulative coincide here.

expenditures.detail: DELTA of +0.30. The five transcribed rows sum to 1195.91; the Form B printed TOTAL and cover line 3 both read 1,195.61. TRACE: the printed total is NOT in doubt - it is written identically on the schedule, on cover line 3, and it closes the cover's own balance chain exactly (300.00 - 1195.61 = -895.61, the printed line-4 figure), and the December filing repeats all three figures. So the residual is either the filer's own addition error or a 0.30 misread of one cents group. The only two candidates are row 3 '.87' and row 4 '.88'; if either were '.57'/'.58' the schedule would close to the cent. Both were escalated to 2400 dpi and to a 600-dpi 4x LANCZOS upscale, and both read as the writer's angular 8 (the same glyph he uses for the 8 in '812'). The December filing's independently-scanned photocopy of the same sheet reads identically - correlated evidence, not confirmation. Rows are published VERBATIM and unadjusted with needs_review=1 on every row of the side.
